subject: Dungeon Map
text: Lighting both torches on the square platform in the center of the room with Din's Fire reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Stand on this platform and use Din's Fire to light both the torches beside you.  A large chest appears here, possibly right where you are standing, open it up and collect the DUNGEON MAP for this dungeon.

subject: Small Key
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees ignites a torch, which can be used with Deku Sticks to light the three other torches in the room and unlock a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Climb around the room and collect all five of the Silver Rupees.  When you do this a torch sets on fire, you're going to need that.  Equip the Deku Stick and light it one fire, there are three torches in this room to light using the Deku Stick as well.  When you light them all, open the chest to get a SMALL KEY and then head onward.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula 095 is located above the locked door and can be retrieved using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Turn around and look above the door, equip the Boomerang and get the GOLD SKULLTULA [095].

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: The Iron Knuckle deals up to four hearts of damage per attack and takes at least seven or eight jump attacks to defeat as a child.

evidence.quote: His attacks can deal up to four hearts worth of damage.  He has two types of attacks, a double horizontal slash and a powerful over head slash.  The basic tactic for both of them is the same, avoid it and use the jump attack...It takes a hell of a lot of hits to defeat this guy, even using the jump attack it's at least seven or eight.

subject: Silver Gauntlets
text: A large treasure chest outside the door behind the Iron Knuckle's throne contains the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: After he is defeated, head through the door behind the throne.  It leads you outside where you will have to listen to that stupid owl.  After doing so be very careful to avoid falling off the ledge and open the large treasure chest to acquire the SILVER GAUNTLETS.

subject: Compass
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce emblem spawns a treasure chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Defeat the wolf monster and then stand on the Triforce emblem and play Zelda's Lullaby to spawn a treasure chest.  Use the Longshot to hook onto the treasure chest and open it up to acquire the COMPASS.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Song of Time beside the blue block reveals Gold Skulltula 096 behind it.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time beside the blue block in the middle on the left (right, A, down, right, A, down).  Behind it you will find the next GOLD SKULLTULA [096].

subject: Small Key
text: A small treasure chest in the room past the boulder area contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: There is only a small treasure chest in this room containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Mirror puzzle
text: Rotating the central mirror so the light shines on the third sun opens the way, while the other suns spawn trapped chests.

evidence.quote: After the enemy is defeated, grab hold of the thing in the middle and rotate it so that the light shines on the third sun, ignore the treasure chests that come out of the other ones, they are trapped chests.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula 097 is located on a platform across from the torch ledge at the top of the stairs and can be reached using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: There is a GOLD SKULLTULA [097] right beside him and you can take it out using the Longshot from this ledge.

subject: Small Key
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol on the statue's hand spawns a chest in the other hand containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Equip the Hover Boots and run along the air to land in the hand of the statue, there is a Triforce symbol here, stand on it and play Zelda's Lullaby to spawn a treasure chest.  Use the Longshot to grab hold of the chest in the other hand and launch to it.  Open the chest to acquire a SMALL KEY.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: A chest on the platform across from where the Hover Boots were used contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Climb back up the staircase that you were just on once again, and notice that across from where you used the Hover Boots, there is now another chest.  Longshot to it and open it for a BLUE RUPEE, then equip the Megaton Hammer and pound the rusted button down to open the door below, drop down and go through.

subject: Recovery Heart
text: Using the Lens of Truth reveals two hidden treasure chests in the hallway, each containing a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: In this next hallway equip the Lens of Truth and you'll see two treasure chests, one contains a RECOVERY HEART and the other contains a RECOVERY HEART as well.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: The Iron Knuckle can be defeated in four jump attacks when using the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: Another battle against an Iron Knuckle occurs in this room, but with the Biggoron's Sword it takes only a mere four jump attacks to kill him, and the range is much longer, so overall this enemy is much much easier.

subject: Mirror Shield
text: A large treasure chest outside contains the Mirror Shield.

evidence.quote: Leave the room and go outside, here you will find a large treasure chest containing the MIRROR SHIELD.

subject: Small Key
text: Reflecting the beam of light onto the sun on the wall using the Mirror Shield unlocks the door leading to a Small Key.

evidence.quote: There is a beam of light coming into the room, stand in the beam with the Mirror Shield equipped and reflect the light up to the sun on the wall.  This will unlock the door beside you and allow you to go through and get SMALL KEY.

subject: Boss Key
text: Shooting the eye switch behind the bombable door, Longshotting to the ceiling panel, and pressing the button on the high platform unlocks the chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: When it explodes equip the Fairy Bow and the Longshot, fire an arrow at the eyeball behind the door and then Longshot to the panel on the ceiling, you should land on a platform.  Jump from this platform to the other platform and step on the button, then drop down and open the chest to get the BOSS KEY.

subject: Sorceress Sisters Twinrova
text: In phase one of Twinrova, Link must deflect one sister's elemental beam attack with the Mirror Shield onto the other sister, hitting each two or three times.

evidence.quote: In order to defeat the bosses what you have to do is deflect the beam of one boss and aim it at another boss.  The beam is constant so you'll be able to swing it around for a couple seconds in hope of hitting the other boss...Each of them must take two or three hits before the second phase begins.

subject: Sorceress Sisters Twinrova
text: In phase two, Link must absorb three identical elemental attacks in a row with the Mirror Shield to blast Twinrova out of the sky, requiring two knockdowns with the Biggoron's Sword to defeat her.

evidence.quote: You need to absorb three of the same elements in a row and then that will fire off a blast at the boss and knock her down...With the Biggoron's Sword you should only have to knock her out two times before she dies.

subject: Sorceress Sisters Twinrova
text: Defeating the boss Twinrova rewards Link with a Heart Container.

evidence.quote: Defeating the boss nets you a HEART CONTAINER after the scene, then as usual

subject: Spirit Medallion
text: Link is brought to see the sages and receives the Spirit Medallion after completing the temple.

evidence.quote: you will be brought to see the sages and be given the SPIRIT MEDALLION.

subject: Piece of Heart [036]
text: Piece of Heart 036 is found in the exact center at the very bottom of the deep water in Zora's Fountain by sinking with the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: Stand on the ice and equip the Iron Boots, jump down into the deep water.  In the exact centre at the very bottom you will find PIECE OF HEART [036], the final piece of heart which will bring your total heart containers up to twenty.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Lifting the large rock outside the cave with the Silver Gauntlets at night and using the Lens of Truth leads to a ladder where Gold Skulltula 098 is on the left wall.

evidence.quote: In front of the cave there is a large rock, lift it up using the Silver Gauntlets and drop down.  Equip the Lens of Truth so you can see the Skulltulas here.  Climb the ladder at the end and look at the wall on your left to find GOLD SKULLTULA [098].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula 099 is located on the wall to the left along the path leading from the king's room to the top of the waterfall.

evidence.quote: From the king's room that the path leading to the top of the waterfall and look to your left, there you should see another GOLD SKULLTULA [099].

subject: Light Arrow
text: Warping to the Temple of Time triggers a scene where Link is granted the Light Arrow.

evidence.quote: First before you do anything, play the Prelude of Light and warp to the Temple of Time.  Here you will trigger a scene, when it is all over Link will be granted the LIGHT ARROW which allows you to fire arrows of light from your Fairy Bow.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Gold Skulltula 100 appears at night behind one of the rocks near the climbable wall after breaking them with the Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote: As you approach the top, in the path were all the rocks are before the climbable wall, break the rocks using your Megaton Hammer.  During the night, the final GOLD SKULLTULA [100] will appear on the wall behind one of these rocks.

subject: Huge Rupee
text: Speaking to the guy in the middle of the House of Skulltula rewards Link with a Huge Rupee that can be collected an infinite number of times.

evidence.quote: Enter the House of Skulltula and speak to the guy in the middle, your reward for all this work is a pathetic HUGE RUPEE.  The only redeeming fact is that you can leave the house and come back to get an infinite number of them, but the real reward is the accomplishment.
